payload.text: 0.1.9's rollout, later (hv's decision 5, 2026-11-13; ST0003/WP06, closing ISSUE:0003). The cut is out: v0.1.9 at 2762bbf, published 12:04:31Z with signed and notarized Mac archives, formula cf77911 in the tap. The rollout's steps: ccusage doctor; ccusage which, then the first ccusage use for an account no running session is pinned to (25 sessions on hello and 2 on engineering01 at 10:55Z; engineering02 and engineering04 had none); doctor again; fresh shells, which Molt's env.sh leaves without CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR once ccusage dir prints nothing; sessions restarted, never switching to an account a session is still pinned to; the live switch (AC-06.1, AC-06.2); then dc closes ISSUE:0003 and vc closes WP06. Back-out: ccusage use --none. Until the rollout nobody runs ccusage use or ccusage which --use on 0.1.9, on any Mac, gyges included. The steps are in intent/wip.md and in vc's scratchpad file closing-sequence-0.1.9.md.
